name: 228. Converted chat keeps the chat wire shape on /openai (gpt-5.5)
description: The compat plugin's force_reasoning_only_models_to_responses (on by default) sends chat requests for models whose datasheet sets supports_reasoning_with_tool_calls false (openai gpt-5.5) to the Responses API. The /openai drop-in route echoed the provider's raw response bytes for OpenAI, so with send_back_raw_response on, a chat client got Responses events (response.created, object "response") and failed its schema check (opencode via @ai-sdk/openai-compatible). Converted responses now carry extra_fields.converted_request_type and the drop-in route re-serializes them. These cases pin that every frame, and the unary body, is chat-shaped.
